name: which-partner-decision-flow
brief:
Title top-left "Which partner closes the gap". Accurate top-to-bottom binary decision tree. Charcoal start pill "Start with what you have" connects DOWN to light grey first DIAMOND "Network access agreement?". Branch "Yes" heads LEFT to a second diamond "Operating systems?". Branch "No" heads RIGHT to a third diamond "Operating systems?". Exactly THREE diamonds total, each path passes through TWO.
LEFT operating systems diamond: branch "No" → orange result "MVNE"; branch "Yes" → pale orange result "Run it yourself".
RIGHT operating systems diamond: branch "Yes" → orange result "MVNA or direct host"; branch "No" → orange result "Combined MVNE and MVNA, or separate suppliers".
There are FOUR separate leaf result boxes total. The word "No" must label the branch leading to the combined supplier leaf. White text on orange boxes. Put leaves on bottom row, wrap text neatly. Leave a far-right margin column for a SEPARATE dashed pale-blue side box: "Deep control, volume and telecom engineers -> MNO host agreement". It is a note, not a fifth leaf. No crossings, no truncated labels, sufficient space for long combined leaf. Do not duplicate or omit nodes.
